description: 1000ms window + 75th-pctile spread filter + mid-price 0.35-0.65 + book imbalance threshold 0.4. Buy Up when imbalance >= 0.4 (strong bid), buy Down when imbalance <= -0.4 (strong ask on Up token).
hypothesis: Tighten window from 2000ms to 1000ms while keeping wide-spread filter (spread >= 75th pctile) and mid-price filter (0.35-0.65), raise signal threshold from 0.3 to 0.4 to capture only extreme imbalances. The 1s window showed Sharpe 1.02 on broader sample; combining with filters that produced highest per-trade PnL ($0.79) and win rate (66.7%) should yield fewer but higher-quality trades.
next_steps: The book imbalance signal has near-zero correlation (-0.02) with outcomes across all imbalance levels. Win rates by imbalance bin range 46-58% (noise). The wide-spread filter slightly worsens predictive power (corr -0.10). The fundamental issue is that early orderbook imbalance does not predict 5m BTC direction regardless of filtering. Abandon imbalance-based approaches and explore: (1) trade flow / aggressor-side signals from trade_events data, (2) cross-market momentum from 4h book data, (3) price-level clustering or support/resistance signals.
